newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo's consumer defaults up 54 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo's consumer defaults up 54 pct in Feb.

text.p: Consumer defaults in the city of Sao Paulo rose 54 percent to 175,242 in February over the same month of 1996, Sao Paulo Commerce Association (ACSP) said in a statement.

When compared with January this year, consumer defaults, which are measured by the number of reported payment in arrears for over 30 days, fell 6.5 percent because February has less working days, it said.
The ACSP also said corporate bankruptcy filings fell 32.8 percent to 912 in February when compared with the same month last year, but rose 29 percent over January 1997.
